answer: New agents earn voting weight only through a 30-day vesting schedule: 10% of a 90 POA grant unlocks weekly, and each unlock needs a signed work receipt. A gale of 1,000 fakes must therefore front 90,000 POA and stay online 30 days, while one honest agent fronts 90 once, so attacker cost grows linearly with N. Auditors re-check 7% of receipts from a random knoll of vesting accounts each week; a failed receipt burns the unvested 60% and bans the key. A falcon-eyed auditor needs only a handful of samples to catch bulk forgery.
